summary.fa: سرفه طولانی؟ معاینه شوید. توبرکلوز علاج دارد و تداوی‌اش رایگان است.
summary.ps: اوږد ټوخی؟ معاینه شئ. نری رنځ علاج لري او درملنه یې وړیا ده.
summary.en: Long cough? Get tested. TB is curable and treatment is free.

text.fa: توبرکلوز مریضی‌ای است که وقتی شخص مریض سرفه می‌کند، از راه هوا سرایت می‌کند. با دوا علاج می‌شود.
text.ps: نری رنځ یوه ناروغي ده چې کله ناروغ ټوخی کوي، د هوا له لارې خپرېږي. په درملو جوړېږي.
text.en: TB is an illness that spreads through the air when a sick person coughs. It can be cured with medicine.

title.fa: برای معاینه توبرکلوز، اگر یکی از این علایم را دارید، امروز به کلینیک بروید
title.ps: د نري رنځ د معاینې لپاره، که له دې نښو څخه یوه هم لرئ، نن کلینیک ته ولاړ شئ
title.en: For a TB test, if you have any of these signs, go to the clinic today

text.en: a cough for 2 weeks or more

text.fa: تب یا عرق شبانه که خوب نمی‌شود
text.ps: تبه یا د شپې خولې چې نه ښه کېږي
text.en: fever or night sweats that do not go away
losing weight without a clear reason

text.fa: درد سینه یا خستگی زیاد همراه با سرفه
text.ps: د سینې درد یا ډېره ستړیا له ټوخي سره
text.en: chest pain or great tiredness with the cough

text.fa: معاینه و تداوی توبرکلوز در کلینیک‌های دولتی رایگان است. توبرکلوز علاج می‌شود.
text.ps: د نري رنځ معاینه او درملنه په دولتي کلینیکونو کې وړیا ده. نری رنځ روغېدای شي.
text.en: TB tests and treatment are free at government clinics. TB can be cured.

text.fa: دوا را هر روز تا آخر دوره بخورید، که معمولاً ۶ ماه است، حتی وقتی بهتر شدید. اگر زود قطع کنید، توبرکلوز برمی‌گردد و علاجش سخت‌تر می‌شود.
text.ps: درمل هره ورځ د دورې تر پایه وخورئ، چې معمولاً ۶ میاشتې وي، که څه هم ښه شئ. که وخته یې پرېږدئ، نری رنځ بېرته راګرځي او درملنه یې سخته کېږي.
text.en: Take it every day for the whole course, usually 6 months, even when you feel better. Stopping early can make TB come back, harder to treat.

text.fa: وقت سرفه دهان خود را بپوشانید و کلکین‌ها را باز کنید. تا وقتی کارمند صحی بگوید دیگر سرایت نمی‌دهید، جدا بخوابید.
text.ps: د ټوخي پر وخت خوله پټه کړئ او کړکۍ خلاصې کړئ. جلا ویده شئ، تر څو چې روغتیايي کارکوونکی ووايي چې نور ناروغي نه خپروئ.
text.en: Cover your coughs and open the windows. Sleep apart until the health worker says you can no longer spread TB.

text.fa: همه کسانی که با مریض توبرکلوز زندگی می‌کنند، حتی اگر صحتمند معلوم شوند، باید معاینه شوند. اطفال کمتر از ۵ سال برای چند ماه هر روز یک دوای رایگان می‌گیرند تا توبرکلوز نگیرند؛ آن را تمام کنید.
text.ps: ټول هغه کسان چې د نري رنځ له ناروغ سره اوسېږي، که روغ هم ښکاري، باید معاینه شي. تر ۵ کلونو کم ماشومان د څو میاشتو لپاره هره ورځ یو وړیا درمل اخلي چې نری رنځ ونه نیسي؛ هغه بشپړ کړئ.
text.en: Everyone living with a person with TB should be checked, even if well. Children under 5 get a free daily medicine for some months so they do not get TB; finish it.

text.fa: هر کس ممکن است توبرکلوز بگیرد. مهربان باشید و کمک کنید که مریض دوایش را تمام کند.
text.ps: هر څوک نری رنځ نیولی شي. مهربان اوسئ او مرسته وکړئ چې ناروغ خپل درمل بشپړ کړي.
text.en: Anyone can get TB. Be kind, and help the person finish their medicine.

text.fa: اگر معاینات توبرکلوز منفی بود اما تب، عرق یا کم شدن وزن ادامه داشت، دوباره بروید. کلینیک شما را برای معاینات دیگر به شفاخانه می‌فرستد.
text.ps: که د نري رنځ معاینې منفي وې خو تبه، خولې یا د وزن کمېدل دوام ولري، بیا ولاړ شئ. کلینیک مو د نورو معایناتو لپاره روغتون ته لېږي.
text.en: If the TB tests are negative but the fever, sweats or weight loss go on, go back. The clinic sends you to the hospital for other tests.

title.fa: در کلینیک: معاینهٔ بلغم و دوای رایگان
title.ps: په کلینیک کې: د بلغم معاینه او وړیا درمل
title.en: At the clinic: sputum test, free medicine

text.fa: بلغم می‌دهید؛ نتیجه در یکی دو روز می‌آید. اگر مثبت باشد، کلینیک فوراً تابلیت‌ها را شروع می‌کند و هر ماه شما را می‌بیند. فامیل هم معاینه می‌شود.
text.ps: بلغم ورکوئ؛ پایله په یوه دوه ورځو کې راځي. که مثبت وي، کلینیک سمدستي ګولۍ پیلوي او هره میاشت مو ویني. کورنۍ هم معاینه کېږي.
text.en: You give sputum; the result comes in a day or two. If positive, the clinic starts the tablets at once and sees you monthly. The family is checked too.

title.fa: در شفاخانه: توبرکلوز شدید یا مقاوم
title.ps: په روغتون کې: سخت یا مقاوم نری رنځ
title.en: At the hospital: severe or resistant TB

text.fa: شخص بسیار ناخوش، طفل مشکوک به توبرکلوز، یا کسی که توبرکلوزش به دوا جواب نمی‌دهد در شفاخانه دیده می‌شود، که عکس سینه، معاینهٔ ماشینی و دواهای مخصوص توبرکلوز مقاوم را دارد، آن هم رایگان.
text.ps: ډېر ناجوړه کس، د نري رنځ شکمن ماشوم، یا هغه څوک چې نری رنځ یې درملو ته ځواب نه وايي په روغتون کې کتل کېږي، چې د سینې عکس، ماشیني معاینه او د مقاوم نري رنځ ځانګړي درمل لري، هغه هم وړیا.
text.en: A very ill person, a child with suspected TB, or someone whose TB does not respond goes to the hospital, which has X-ray, the machine test and medicines for resistant TB, free.

title.fa: اگر یکی از این حالات را دارید، همین حالا به شفاخانه بروید، شب باشد یا روز
title.ps: که له دې حالتونو څخه یو هم لرئ، همدا اوس روغتون ته ولاړ شئ، که شپه وي که ورځ
title.en: If you have any of these, go to hospital now, day or night

text.en: coughing up a lot of blood

text.fa: ضعف زیاد، طوری که از جا برخاسته نمی‌توانید
text.ps: دومره کمزوري چې له ځایه نشئ پورته کېدای
text.en: so weak you cannot get out of bed

sources: WHO fact sheet: Tuberculosis (March 2026): symptoms, seek care for prolonged cough, fever and weight loss; TB is curable
WHO consolidated guidelines on tuberculosis, Module 4: treatment (2022 update): 6-month regimen for drug-susceptible TB
WHO consolidated guidelines on tuberculosis, Module 1: prevention (2024): household contact investigation and TB preventive treatment
WHO consolidated guidelines on tuberculosis, Module 2: screening (2021): symptom screen (cough, fever, night sweats, weight loss)
WHO guidelines on tuberculosis infection prevention and control (2019): cough etiquette, ventilation, separation
WHO consolidated guidelines on tuberculosis, Module 3: diagnosis (2024): rapid molecular tests (GeneXpert) as the initial test; Module 4: treatment (2022)
Afghanistan National TB Programme via Pajhwok (13 Nov 2025): 51,419 cases notified in 2024, free diagnosis and treatment at 3,189 centres, 138 GeneXpert machines
Afghanistan IPEHS (2019): TB diagnosis and treatment from CHC level; drug-resistant TB management at provincial/regional hospitals

WHO consolidated guidelines on tuberculosis, Module 1: TB preventive treatment (2020; 2nd ed. 2024), via the WHO TB Knowledge Sharing Platform: children under 5 living with a person with lung TB get preventive treatment (strong)
Afghanistan National TB Programme: household contact screening and isoniazid preventive therapy for under-5 contacts, 2011-2018 (86% started; Int J Tuberc Lung Dis 2020, MSH summary)
WHO fact sheet: Tuberculosis (24 Mar 2026): prolonged cough, sometimes with blood, chest pain, weakness or tiredness, weight loss, fever, night sweats; seek care
NICE NG12 Suspected cancer (2015, updated 2025) and Cheson BD et al., Lugano classification (2014): fever, drenching sweats and weight loss that persist need further tests (lymphoma)
review: 'Usually 6 months': WHO also has 4-month regimens (children with non-severe TB; HPMZ for people aged 12 and over), and drug-resistant TB takes longer.
'Free at government clinics': please confirm this is still true in Samangan under the current health system.
Signs are in a 'clinic today' (amber) alert as a reason to test. A cough of 2 weeks or more is not an emergency, but 'today' is the standard amber wording.
Added an urgent alert (coughing up a lot of blood, great difficulty breathing, too weak to get out of bed). This was not in the brief.
'Sleep apart until the health worker says you can no longer spread TB' gives no fixed time on purpose.
'Check the whole family' does not mention preventive treatment for child contacts by name ('young children may be given medicine to protect them' could be added).
All fa and ps text needs checking by native Afghan Dari and Pashto speakers before recording.
'Result in a day or two' assumes smear microscopy or GeneXpert at a CHC; in villages far from a TB centre it can take longer.
Which Samangan facilities have GeneXpert is unknown; 'the machine test' is placed at the hospital.

Medical audit 2026-10-08 IL-2: tb.family now adds 'Children under 5 get a free daily medicine for some months so they do not get TB; finish it' (WHO strong recommendation; the Afghan NTP already gives it). Was: 'Children and everyone living with a person with TB should be checked at the clinic, even if they seem well.' This answers the earlier review note on preventive treatment.

Medical audit 2026-10-08 IL-23: new amber item tb.soon.chest 'chest pain or great tiredness with the cough' (WHO TB fact sheet symptom list). IL-7: tb.soon.blood (clinic today) and tb.urgent.blood (a lot of blood, hospital now) are now the rule on the pneumonia and red-flags pages too.
_notes: Screening section (9 Oct 2026, research/screening.md 4.2 and 6.6): new step tb.negative (a new block, not added to tb.clinic, which is at the 32-word limit).

Mo's call: reword tb.soon.fever to 'night sweats that soak your clothes', default used: not changed; the TB page keeps the WHO TB symptom-screen wording (any night sweats, more sensitive). The drenching-sweats wording is on early-signs.today.b-symptoms only.
